NASA’sOctober22 report describes a real Hubble arc-counterarc lens image. Distances4.5/8billion light-years are approximate source descriptions, not independently recalculated redshifts or exact observation dates. Both arcs are one background galaxy, not two objects or physically split matter. Lensing helps infer total mass/dark matter; this is not particle detection/identity or a newly supplied mass/fraction/precision measurement. Roman modeling and follow-up are prospective; no survey yield or launch date established here. Illustration is imagined, not Hubble data. “Successor” does not mean Hubble retires; the report describes complementary work. “Cannot photograph dark matter” is shorthand for this indirect observation, not a universal proof about every possible detection. Opening reactions and image uselessness are rhetoric, not measured audience/science outcomes.

Coverage-gap43/72/31%rates are conditional tests, not real-user breach odds, overall safety ranks or today’s configuration audit. Heatmap cells>=60rollouts and4,000benign actions are separate denominators. Under1%benign blocking applies only to that replay set. Sandboxing/collusion untested; monitor trusted.
